023156:         // A type name may define the aggregate rather than name one:
023157:         // `(union{float _f; uint32_t _i;}){x}` is how a libc's math library
023158:         // punts a float through an integer. The parser registered the
023159:         // definition against the position of its opening brace, which is what
023160:         // identifies it -- the tag lookup below cannot, because an anonymous
023161:         // aggregate has no tag and two of them in one file would collide.
023162:         u32 body_open = index + 1;
023163:         if (body_open < end && builder->preprocess.tokens[body_open].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)

023184:             // Several types may carry one tag -- a block-scope definition
023185:             // shadows a sibling's or the file scope's -- so among candidates
023186:             // visible from the reference the innermost wins, exactly as the
023187:             // parse-side lookup resolves it.  The first match stays the
023188:             // answer when nothing is visible or nothing beats it, which is
023189:             // what every unique-tag unit resolved to before scopes were
023190:             // consulted -- including the forward-declared tag whose pointer
023191:             // typedef was lowered against the opaque made before the

023202:                     {
